national_law.name: Cross-sectoral and sectoral NIS2 laws
national_law.note: Denmark uses a combination of cross-sectoral and sector-specific legislation

management_liability.description: Denmark explicitly chose NOT to include personal liability for management bodies. Notable deviation from the directive. No direct administrative fines - sanctions must follow criminal prosecution process.

penalties.essential_entities: EUR 10,000,000 or 2% of global annual revenue
penalties.important_entities: EUR 7,000,000 or 1.4% of global annual revenue
penalties.note: No direct administrative fines - must follow criminal prosecution process
